summaryZh: QCC lab 研究如何更早检测和预防癌症。实验室利用数学推理理解体细胞进化过程中多尺度癌症数据之间的关联。

evidence.quote: Welcome to the QCC lab We are an interdisciplinary team based at UCSD Department of Medicine, Division of Biomedical Informatics and UCSD Moores Cancer Center .

Our research aim is to improve the ability to detect and prevent cancer at the earliest stages. To achieve this, our team develops ways to use mathematical reasoning to better understand the correlations between multi-scale cancer data arising from the underlying process of somatic evolution.
